decisions.title: PPS 2025 tax returns — how to file

prescott.title: Close Prescott Development LLC · 2026 is the final tax year
prescott.decided: Decided by Juan and Cherry · no decision needed
facts: California LLC, formed May 2015; Juan signs as Managing Member
Mike Zabaneh 30% · Issa Shami 30% · Equity Track / Juan 40%
751 27th Ave, San Mateo: bought $2,100,000, sold $2,900,000 (Stewart Title escrow, est. close Oct 14, 2026)
risks: The 2024 and 2025 Prescott tax returns (Form 1065 and California Form 568) have not been started. The IRS charges about $255 per member, per month late, for up to 12 months, and California won't accept the cancellation until every return is filed.
The 2026 California LLC fee is based on gross receipts, so the $2.9M sale may make it about $6,000; the CPA should confirm.
